RagShortTexts: Commenda contracts pooled landlubber capital with seafarer labor, fueling Mediterranean.

Variants.Content: The commenda contract served as the premier financial instrument driving Mediterranean maritime trade. A sedentary investor (stans) provided venture capital, while a traveling merchant-captain (tractator) navigated the voyage. Profits were typically split three-quarters to the investor and one-quarter to the voyager, while shipwreck losses fell solely upon capital.
Public notaries along Venetian and Genoese docks drafted thousands of parchment commenda deeds. Pooling capital enabled urban widows and small craftsmen to invest in Levantine spice fleets.
Voyaging to Acre or Caffa is a high-stakes gamble against storms and corsairs. But returning with holds laden with cloves and raw silk elevates a deckhand into a prosperous burgher.
